methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Methodology users must identify a region of interest, gather relevant input data including projected energy consumption on a delivered basis and carbon emission factors for various energy types, establish a projection of ISO 50001 uptake for the time period of interest, and select what level of annual savings will be realized from ISO 50001 implementation.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper presents the ISO 50001 Impacts Methodology, an internationally-developed methodology to calculate these impacts at a national, regional, or global scale suitable for use by policymakers.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The ISO 50001 Impacts Methodology has been established to assist policymakers in determining the impact of industrial and commercial (service) sector ISO 50001 implementation on a regional, national, or global scale.

stage1.notes: Aggregate industrial/service-sector impact methodology; no empirical application in an explicitly named continuous-process sector.
